_meta.notes: Every string the interface says in its own voice. Templates use {braces}. The three modes wear verbs, not nouns: Plan, Play, Act, because the loop is the navigation.

chrome.askHead: Take one question to a person
chrome.partBody: Something did not arrive over the connection. The rest of the site is fine, and nothing I did caused it.

pulse.rest: 2 places are open before you pick anything.

load.heavy: A heavy load. Check that you can keep up with all of them.
load.early: Add the rest of your subjects.

ask.move: Ask your {who}: what would it take to move {subject} up?
ask.dest: Ask your ECG counsellor: what is a normal day at {dest} like?
ask.aim: Ask an adult who does this work: what are the hard days like?
ask.open: Ask your form teacher: which of these suits how you learn?

journey.wantPrompt: Before I start. What do I want by 25?
journey.wantHint: I can change my mind later. People do.
journey.asks: This one asks for {disp}. I have {have}.
journey.stretchChip: a stretch for me right now
journey.metChip: I built the footing for this
journey.endWantUnsure: At {age} I said I was not sure yet. That was honest, and it worked.
journey.compareCta: Put two stories side by side
journey.verdict: Same start, different choices. Neither story is the wrong one. My starting point set the first step. It did not write the rest.
journey.verdictCombo: Different subjects, different first steps, and I am both holding doors. The combination started the story. It did not finish it.
journey.stoppedNote: {label} stopped at {age}, at the end of the first qualification. A short game is a whole game.
journey.comboPrompt: Play forward from the subjects I am taking.
journey.comboPick: Set my subjects on my year page
journey.comboNote: This is where my story starts. It is not where it ends.
journey.comboGate: Pick subjects above, or just start.
journey.comboSheet: Tap a level. Nothing here is final and it can change any time.
journey.seeInNow: See these subjects on my year page
journey.toAct: So what now? Take it to My plan
journey.q2: Where do I want to go?
journey.railWhereNone: Not sure yet. Most people are not.
journey.stillTrueNone: At {age} I said I was not sure what I wanted.
journey.efficacyLine: I did the hard one. Now I know I can.
journey.kindsNote: Six kinds of people at work. Most people are a mix of two or three.
journey.tryContrast: I played {a}. Try the opposite kind of life:
journey.turnHint: Points are my time this year. Spend them, then tap That is my year.
journey.handIntro: New: people I can ask. Asking is free and does not spend points.
journey.leftHint: 1 point left. Add one more, or go with this.
journey.startOverArm: Tap again. This story will be gone.
journey.handRule: Asking is free. Two a year. Ask one person and find out who else to ask.
journey.handEmpty: I have asked everyone in my hand.
journey.handUsed: I asked two people this year.
journey.doorTag: a door I hold opened this
journey.whyFull: Seven subjects or more is a fuller year.
journey.whyLight: A lighter subject load leaves room.
journey.whyCca: The CCA I give my evenings to takes its share.
journey.whyFreer: More of my time is mine to direct now.
journey.whyWeek: My week outside lessons is a full one.
journey.whyRoom: There is room in my week outside lessons.
journey.whyNs: Service sets the hours this year.
journey.staleBody: This story is still playing the {old} I started with. Stories keep the subjects they began with, so the one I already played stays true.
journey.staleFresh: Start fresh with my new subjects
journey.staleYear: I was {old} when this story started. I am {new} now.
journey.yearNoWant: I have not named what I want yet. That is allowed, and this still counts.
journey.undoNote: Changed my mind? Put it back the way it was.
journey.runLong: Keep going, all the way to 35
journey.runPick: How far do I want to play?
journey.runShortNote: Thirteen to about twenty. Seven or eight turns, and it fits one lesson. Start here.
journey.runLongNote: The same road carried on through service, work and the years after. Longer, and for a second sitting.
journey.tourHead: Three things and I am playing
journey.tour1: Points are my time this year. Big choices cost 2, small ones cost 1.
journey.tour2: Life deals a chance every year. How I answer it is mine.
journey.tour3: Pick everything I want, then tap That is my year once.
journey.nsYes: NS is part of my road
journey.nsNote: Logged, and the story moves on. Nothing else is asked.
journey.weekPaidNote: I carried {what} through this year. That happens whether or not a turn was spent on it.
journey.classSeedHint: If my teacher gave a play code, put it here. The whole class gets the same luck.
journey.possHead: What else is possible from here
journey.possNote: Real routes, with what each one asks for. Nothing here is closed to me.
journey.possMissedHead: Roads that were open the whole time
journey.possMissedNote: These were live in the years I just played. Most of them still are.
journey.mapNote: The pale lines are the roads I did not take. Notice where they come back.
journey.mapReflect: Put the note I wrote on the card
journey.mapAlt: A transit map of my played life. Every station is named in the list below it.
journey.cardHint: One picture of this story, made on my device. Share it or keep it.
journey.compareHead1: Same start. One chapter went differently.
journey.compareHeadSame: Same start, and the same choices all the way down.
journey.compareRoads: Two starts that matched, and two roads that did not.
journey.efficacyRisk: More nerve than I had banked. Shaky counts.
journey.efficacyPersistence: I did not have the miles yet. I went anyway.
journey.efficacyCuriosity: I asked before I knew how to ask well. The asking improves.
journey.efficacyFlexibility: I bent further than before. Awkward, and it held.
journey.efficacyOptimism: I backed something I was unsure of. It came out uneven.
journey.efficacyRisk2: Nerve I had not banked yet, spent anyway. That is how it gets banked.
journey.efficacyPersistence2: Nobody had shown me how to keep at that. I kept at it.
journey.efficacyCuriosity2: A clumsy question, and an answer I would not have had.
journey.efficacyFlexibility2: I changed the plan mid year. It cost something, and it moved.
journey.efficacyOptimism2: I acted as if it would work out. Half of it did.
journey.wantKnown: I already said this in Act
journey.whyGrown: One more every year now, because I {why}.
journey.waitedHead: What this year could not hold
journey.homeQ: One more, if I want. What does home want for me?
journey.homeHint: Nothing is scored on this. Some outcomes will speak to it, that is all.
journey.endHomeSame: Home wanted what I wanted. That helped, and I still did the walking.
journey.endHomeSteady: Home wanted steady and safe. Some years I gave them that, some years I gave them me.
journey.endHomeTheirs: Home had a road picked. This one is mine, and the door home stayed open.
journey.endHomeUnsaid: We never really talked about what home wanted. The story happened anyway. Maybe I show them this.
journey.endHomeSplit: Home never did agree on one answer. I stopped waiting for it and made mine.
journey.friendAlt: A classmate appears through the years
journey.weekRoom: A light week. Next school year gets an extra point of time.
journey.weekSteady: A steady week. My time points stay as they are.
journey.weekFull: A full week. It takes a point of time each school year, and it pays in what it builds.
journey.weekHours: About {n} hours a week outside lessons.
journey.ccaNote: One tap. It shapes my week every school year, and it never spends a point.
journey.doorKeeps: Held for good. A held door opens choices later in the story.

aim.chooserLede: Not a job title. A shape of life, and more than one road to it.
aim.workHead: Where that kind of work actually happens

teacher.playHead: Class play: same luck for everyone
teacher.playIntro: Generate a play code and read it out. Every student who enters it gets the same chances in the same order, so the debrief compares answers instead of luck.
teacher.playNote: The code seeds the game's randomness and carries nothing else.
